title: $1,000 in Facebook in 2012 is now worth this
caption:
In 2012, Facebook was a social network.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:META:2012-05-18} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Facebook in 2012? 👇
sources: Facebook price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2012, Facebook was a social network.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
